text:
maya: Heads up — I just noticed a ~15% invoice delta in staging reports. Numbers on the per-route billing dashboard don't match the raw ingest counts.

oliver: Which pipeline stage is diverging? ingest events -> aggregator -> metering?

maya: Looks like aggregator windowing. The hourly watermark rounding changed after the TTL tweak last week.

sabrina: That TTL change was the 6h->2h retention for intermediate aggregator tables (PR #412). I warned it would affect long-tail sessions. link: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/412

kevin: Console is showing the invoice preview using the new aggregator snapshot by default. If snapshots are missing we should fallback to event-store counts. Right now it shows blanks.

anuj: Can we get a quick SQL to reproduce the delta? I can run on staging.

sabrina: repro query (staging):
```sql
WITH agg AS (SELECT tenant_id, route, SUM(tokens) as tk FROM aggregator_hourly WHERE ts >= now()-interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT a.route, a.tk, e.tk_raw FROM agg a LEFT JOIN (SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tk_raw FROM event_ingest WHERE ts >= now()-interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1) e USING (route);
```

ben: ingest-bot alert fired at 1738298000 with count_drop=0.12 for partition eu-west-1, looks correlated.

ingest-bot: alert: partition eu-west-1: hourly_aggregator_nulls > 0 for 3 consecutive hours. link: https://alerts.internal/alerts/9832

oliver: So two issues: (1) aggregator retention window truncated long-tail events, (2) console picks whatever snapshot exists. UX should show "estimated" and use event-store when snapshot incomplete.

console-ux: We can add an "estimation source" toggle and a small badge. But we need a consistent contract: snapshot_age < X && completeness_pct > Y -> prefer snapshot else fallback. What thresholds?

kevin: Suggest snapshot_age < 1h and completeness_pct >= 98%. If <98% show "estimated" and allow manual override in preview.

anuj: For quick mitigation, can we extend retention back to 6h on staging until we roll a fix? That should make the numbers line up.

sabrina: I can revert the TTL change for staging now. For prod we'll need a migration: backfill missing aggregator rows or change aggregation to be event-store first.

maya: Action items: sabrina revert TTL in staging (in flight), anuj run the repro SQL + produce diff csv, console-ux to draft badge copy and fallback rule, kevin add a short-term UI override flag in preview.

ben: I'll annotate the incident ticket and notify billing ops slack channel if prod shows same. ticket: https://tickets.internal/RED-6321

oliver: One more thought — add a daily reconcile job that compares aggregator vs event-store and emits a reconciliation score. If score < 99% prevent invoice-preview auto-publish.

maya: love that. Can someone take the reconcile job on?

anuj: I can prototype it today and push a canary to staging.

console-ux: I'll prepare copy: "Numbers may be incomplete — using best available snapshot" + tooltip explaining fallback.

sabrina: TTL revert done on staging: terraform apply successful. Will watch metrics.

ingest-bot: info: terraform apply completed by sabrina at 1738304002.

maya: thanks. please post reconciliation CSV in the ticket and we can close this thread once staging aligns. :thumbsup:
